name: Kienstock
source: eHYD, Hydrographischer Dienst Österreich (BML), yearbook series Q-Tagesmittel; station operator via donau
license: CC BY 4.0 (Open Government Data Austria, per the INSPIRE metadata record; not shown on ehyd.gv.at itself)
flag_rule: eHYD gives no per-value flag, so values are measured, except whole months whose station footnote says discharge was computed from filled-in levels, that data were filled ('ergänzt'), or that discharge was affected by ice ('durch Eis beeinflusst'); those are estimated.
notes: Discharge at Kienstock is computed from the water level through a rating curve (Pegelschlüssel); the station master data list these discharge methods (start, end, method): 01.01.1976 to now: Pegelschlüssel-händische Messung; 01.01.1976 to now: unbestimmt-händische Messung (eHYD).

Daily mean discharge from the eHYD yearbook export, series (10001016,Abfluss,I,Mit,T,1,F,Z,50,,,), period 01.01.1978 00:00,01.01.2024 00:00. eHYD publishes only checked yearbook data, so the series ends with the last published yearbook year, 2023 (eHYD).

Footnotes say discharge was affected by ice in: 1997: Im Jän,Dez durch Eis beeinflusst; 2005: Im Jän,Feb,Mrz,Apr,Mai,Okt,Nov,Dez durch Eis beeinflusst. Those 10 months are marked estimated, like ice-affected days at USGS and ECCC gauges (eHYD station master data).
Other discharge footnotes: 01.01.2018: JB 2018: Neuberechnung des Flusskilometers (eHYD).

Rows in the file: 16801; calendar days missing between first and last value: 0. Gap markers ('Lücke') skipped: 1 (2024-01-01; a marker on the day after the last value only closes the series). Fill values dropped: 0. Negative values dropped: 0 (eHYD).
